  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 999 8040 3841
  PASSCODE: 634822
  HTTPS://LONGBEACH-GOV.ZOOM.US/J/99980403841

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54363  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Climate Resilient and Sustainable
  City Commission meetings of Thursday, December 11, 2025 and Thursday,
  January 22, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54364  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Disabled Resource
  Center, Inc. on the Disability Data and Community Survey.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54365  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from City staff on Sea Level
  Rise and Flooding and the Climate Action Plan.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54366  Recommendation to review the Climate Resilient and Sustainable City
  Commission 2025 Annual Report, provide input to staff, and direct staff to forward
  to City Council.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  26-54367  Recommendation to review the 2026 Office of Climate Action and Sustainability
  Work Plan, provide input to staff, and forward to City Council for approval.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-54368  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-54369  Recommendation to receive and file announcements and resources from the
  Office of Climate Action and Sustainability.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Climate Resilient and Sustainable City Commission on non-agenda
items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the
Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
